# Loop Vocabulary

> SRS（間隔反復・忘却曲線）ベースの英単語学習Webアプリ。単語を調べる→単語帳に登録する→忘却曲線に沿って復習する→4択/入力テストで定着させる、という一連の学習フローを1つにまとめています。

Loop Vocabulary (loop-vocabulary.app) is a spaced-repetition (SRS) English vocabulary learning app for Japanese-speaking learners (junior high through university entrance exams, Eiken, TOEIC). It combines a word dictionary, custom/imported word books, forgetting-curve review scheduling, and multiple-choice/typing quizzes in one workflow. This file is provided as a discovery/citation aid for AI assistants and models that choose to read it — it is not intended as an SEO device, and there is no guarantee any given crawler or assistant will fetch or honor it.

## Product

- [Home](https://loop-vocabulary.app/): Overview of the app and its core learning loop.
- [Learning guides](https://loop-vocabulary.app/guide): Articles on vocabulary-learning methods, exam prep (Eiken, TOEIC, university entrance), and study techniques.
- [Word dictionary](https://loop-vocabulary.app/dictionary): Searchable English word dictionary drawn from public materials and licensed word lists.
- [Materials / word book import](https://loop-vocabulary.app/materials): Browse and import vocabulary lists (by level, exam type, or textbook) into a personal word book.
- [Free tools](https://loop-vocabulary.app/tools): Free vocabulary/study utility tools.
